hypothesis.statement: The Morlet-wavelet scalogram of eyes-closed occipital (O1) EEG (eegmmidb S001R02) is dominated by the alpha rhythm (peak power ~10 Hz), and waveletTransform reproduces MNE-Python's tfr_array_morlet in time-frequency structure (correlation ~1) up to a normalization convention.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S001, eyes-closed baseline run R02, occipital channel O1, first 10 s (1600 samples) at 160 Hz

decision.threshold: descriptive: the scalogram peaks in the alpha band (dominant frequency 8-13 Hz), and waveletTransform reproduces MNE tfr_array_morlet in structure (correlation >= 0.99)
